svg.title: Visual comparison of the supercharger diagnostic in SW404 and SW338
svg.text: FROM ENGINE LOAD MODELS TO SUPERCHARGER SHUTDOWN
404 vs 338 · bank 1 · same operating point · a reproduced conditional case
Original ROM tables. Highlighted cells are used in the example. Actual vehicle states and adaptation remain unconfirmed.
Same WOT point and enabling conditions; 338 coding 2
Only the 338 comparison is unfavorable in this example.
Both comparisons are unfavorable; shutdown still requires confirmation.

g.text: Passes this example; other inputs can still cause overflow
INPUTS CHOSEN TO REPRODUCE THIS CASE
WOT = 100% · RPM ≥ 5000 · clutch commanded ON · MAF substitution active
Single ON model · IAT factor = 122 · adaptation = 129 · FD06.2 = 1
Diagnostic enabled. These are test inputs, not recorded vehicle measurements.
The MAF diagnostic allows model substitution
Nominal value shown in the definitions. The
first quantized step above it corresponds to
An excess is assumed already confirmed:
The checked signal is upstream of substitution. OBD MAF can report a different value.
ON and OFF are calculated at the same RPM and throttle
OFF is also calculated with the clutch ON
It estimates load without the supercharger. This result supplies the
diagnostic divisor. The clutch stays commanded ON.
208 is the byte that differs from the 338
This cell contains 208. The 338 coding 2 model contains 209 at the
Cells use the definition units. Common colour scale: internal byte 0 to 255. Indices start at 0.
Temperature and adaptation correct both models
Byte 122 / 128 = 0.953125 at the selected 30 °C node. °C ranges reflect ADC quantization.
Selected IAT node: raw 144 → 30 °C. Factor 122 is a multiplier numerator; 128 means unity.
Each arrow discards the fractional part. Product saturation is not reached in this example.
ON supplies the load and OFF builds the divisor
199 × 32 = 6368 load units. The program uses this value before
filtering and the RPM-dependent load cap.
102 / 4 = 25.5 → 25. The fraction is discarded. This divisor varies
with the model and its corrections.
25 is not a ROM constant. It comes from the corrected OFF model at this point.
The program keeps only the lowest eight bits
This value fits in one byte and is preserved.
The minimum threshold is checked and the fault confirmed
Byte 188 = minimum threshold the stored ratio must exceed
CONDITIONS AND CONSTANTS READ BY THE DIAGNOSTIC
This test does not set fault FD36.12
A favorable comparison resets the failure-confirmation counter.
Still vulnerable: IAT factor 122 + adaptation 130 gives Q = 257 → byte 1.
OFF reference: RAM 0x83e7 · load: 0x8ec0 · quotient byte: 0x8ec4
Block-level test with synthetic RAM. Coding 2, diagnostic eligibility and this fault have not been recorded during the actual vehicle event.
Fails this example; shares the same vulnerable operation
INPUTS CHOSEN TO REPRODUCE THIS CASE
WOT = 100% · RPM ≥ 5000 · clutch commanded ON · MAF substitution active
Coding 2 in RAM · IAT factor = 122 · adaptation = 129 · FD06.2 = 1
Diagnostic enabled. These are test inputs, not recorded vehicle measurements.
The MAF diagnostic allows model substitution
Nominal value shown in the definitions. The
first quantized step above it corresponds to
An excess is assumed already confirmed:
The checked signal is upstream of substitution. OBD MAF can report a different value.
ON and OFF are calculated at the same RPM and throttle
OFF is also calculated with the clutch ON
It estimates load without the supercharger. This result supplies the
diagnostic divisor. The clutch stays commanded ON.
Cells use the definition units. Common colour scale: internal byte 0 to 255. Indices start at 0.
Temperature and adaptation correct both models
Byte 122 / 128 = 0.953125 at the selected 30 °C node. °C ranges reflect ADC quantization.
Selected IAT node: raw 144 → 30 °C. Factor 122 is a multiplier numerator; 128 means unity.
Each arrow discards the fractional part. Product saturation is not reached in this example.
ON supplies the load and OFF builds the divisor
200 × 32 = 6400 load units. The program uses this value before
filtering and the RPM-dependent load cap.
102 / 4 = 25.5 → 25. The fraction is discarded. This divisor varies
with the model and its corrections.
25 is not a ROM constant. It comes from the corrected OFF model at this point.
The program keeps only the lowest eight bits
It does not clamp to 255: it discards the high byte.
The minimum threshold is checked and the fault confirmed
Byte 188 = minimum threshold the stored ratio must exceed
CONDITIONS AND CONSTANTS READ BY THE DIAGNOSTIC
The clutch command is removed and the normal bypass command is forced to 0 (open).
Clearing requires clutch ON; the latch itself prevents that normal recovery.
OFF reference: RAM 0x8411 · load: 0x8e44 · quotient byte: 0x8e48
Block-level test with synthetic RAM. Coding 2, diagnostic eligibility and this fault have not been recorded during the actual vehicle event.
